query:
SELECT 
  DATE(saleDate) as data,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as faturamento
FROM sales 
WHERE saleDate >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND saleDate < '2026-02-01'
  AND status NOT LIKE '%CANCELADO%'
GROUP BY DATE(saleDate)
ORDER BY data DESC
LIMIT 10
